protocol.oracle: Every locked VNDB production-sized source group is CRC-validated and parsed by the unchanged native producer. A and B copy the same borrowed chunk synchronously; complete nested outputs are deep-equal before the next heap reuse. Raw source bytes and borrowed semantics are unchanged.
protocol.timingBoundary: Shared validated glossary bytes through returned image path strings only. Excludes source inflate/parse, remaining chunk copies, worker IPC, OPFS, and UI. This is not a complete-import or process-memory benchmark.
protocol.controls: A and C call the exact same existing JSON collector and private SharedArrayBuffer snapshot path. B attempts the new projector then the same fallback.
